arby.lead: The current Arbitration and the schedule for the next 12 hours. Arbitrations change every hour. Get the schedule with "Data Update" or "Refetch schedule".
arby.nodata: No Arbitration schedule yet. Press "Refetch schedule" or "Data Update".
arby.range: The saved schedule has run out. Press "Refetch schedule".
arby.noregions: Node names are not available yet, so internal names are shown. Run Data Update to show node names, mission types and enemies.
arby.oldregions: The node name data is old, so mission types and enemies are unknown. Run Data Update again.
arby.note: Times use the PC clock (corrected by the cycle time sync) in the format of the selected language. The schedule comes from browse.wf (https://browse.wf/). If it differs from the game, trust the game.
